reviewSamples.author: Photo of Erika Esnard
reviewSamples.text: One of my favorite places in Miami! The gluten free empanadas are out of this world and they have my favorite coffee, Julius Meinl. The service is always amazing. Worth the drive.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sarah D
reviewSamples.text: Love this place! The empanadas are fresh and out of this world. Love the ham & cheese as well as the beef. I have not tried the pastries yet but they look so delicious!
